high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post contains two points about the benefits of a central bank digital currency (CBDC): Point 4: A digital currency monitored by the Central Bank can be tracked more easily, making it easier to detect frauds committed using the CBDC. Point 5: Payments could be processed instantly through central bank infrastructure, dramatically reducing the cost of transactions. The post includes a logo at the bottom that reads "MOM" with the tagline "Mad Over Marketing.
